summary: A mosque-like structure featuring a central building with a stepped, elongated vaulted roof and horizontal material banding, surrounded by four tall minaret-style towers at the corners of a rectangular courtyard.

shape.overall_form: Central vaulted structure flanked by four tall corner towers
shape.symmetry: Asymmetrical central building, symmetrical tower placement

materials.name: brick
materials.role: Primary wall material for towers and central building

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: Tower corners, main roof, and base bands

materials.name: quartz_block
materials.role: Horizontal decorative bands and courtyard fence

materials.name: nether_brick
materials.role: Flat roof accents on towers and main roof ridge

materials.name: wood
materials.role: Lower horizontal band above the base

rebuild_hints: Lay out the rectangular courtyard perimeter first using the white block fence.
Erect the four corner towers using brick walls with stonebrick edges, topping them with flat, overhanging roofs.
Build the central structure with 3 distinct floors, separated by prominent white horizontal bands.
Construct the main roof as a stepped vault using stonebrick, finishing the top ridge with a flat layer of dark blocks.
Pay close attention to the top-down views to replicate the asymmetrical side extension on the main building's footprint.
uncertainties: Exact dimensions and block counts are estimated from the images.
The specific material of the white blocks (could be quartz, white concrete, or snow).
The material of the yellowish horizontal band near the base is unclear (could be oak wood planks, sandstone, or gold).
